description: This file contains utility functions under the GuzzleHttp namespace, providing support for type description, header parsing, debugging resources, choosing HTTP handlers based on environment, system CA bundle retrieval, header normalization, host proxy checks, JSON encoding/decoding with error handling, time measurement, and IDN URI conversions.

classes.name: Utils
classes.description: A final class providing static utility methods for various common operations used within the Guzzle HTTP client library.

methods.name: describeType
methods.description: Returns a descriptive string of the input's type and class if object.

methods.name: headersFromLines
methods.description: Parses header lines into an associative array of headers.

methods.name: debugResource
methods.description: Returns a resource for debugging purposes based on the input or environment.

methods.name: chooseHandler
methods.description: Selects and creates an appropriate default HTTP handler based on the environment capabilities.

methods.name: defaultUserAgent
methods.description: Returns default User-Agent string for Guzzle.

methods.name: defaultCaBundle
methods.description: Retrieves the system's default CA bundle file path from common locations or PHP ini settings.

methods.name: normalizeHeaderKeys
methods.description: Normalizes header keys to lowercase while preserving their original casing.

methods.name: isHostInNoProxy
methods.description: Checks if a host matches any pattern in a no-proxy list.

methods.name: jsonDecode
methods.description: Decodes JSON string, throws exception on error.

methods.name: jsonEncode
methods.description: Encodes data to JSON, throws exception on error.

methods.name: currentTime
methods.description: Returns the current time in seconds as a float, using hrtime() if available.

methods.name: idnUriConvert
methods.description: Converts a URI host to ASCII using IDN standards.

methods.name: getenv
methods.description: Retrieves environment variable from server or environment.
